text.tspan: For this project, I designed a virtual assistant aimed at
helping users create and manage organizational
procedures. It was a particularly challenging project since
there were no clear references for what we needed yet — a
hybrid between a chatbot and an interactive platform.
This required extensive research across different industries
to understand how similar technologies could be adapted
to our context. I learned a lot throughout the process,
especially about designing complex UI components and
integrating AI capabilities into a user-centered experience.
